newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent and NYMEX ease, but downside limited.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent and NYMEX ease, but downside limited.

text.p: SIMEX Brent futures were slightly lower in late trading on Tuesday, attracting some profit taking after the overnight rally in London and New York futures.
However, brokers said they saw limited downside amid clashes between rival Kurdish groups in northern Iraq and worries Iraq and Iran could become embroiled in the conflict.
November Brent futures were last traded at $24.80 per barrel, down six cents from London's overnight close of $24.86. December last traded down six at $24.32.
NYMEX crude, which rose 96 cents to $25.62 in New York on Monday, was last traded at $25.55.
Pro-Baghdad Kurds launched a counter attack on Tuesday to take back the key town of Koy Sanjak.
Iraq and Iran have effectively taken sides in the Kurdish struggle, although witnessess did not report any signs of their forces being involved in the latest clash.
